label: Dzen
terms_note: Dzen offers channel owners an RSS import for sites (full-text or link mode, moderated) and the Dzen Studio UI; no public write API for articles / posts; Russian platform (sanctions review pending).

capabilities: post(RSS import into a connected channel)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (RSS import only; no write API).
reference.limits: - Dzen content rules (originality, no clickbait, advertising labelling under Russian law); RU platform: sanctions compliance may restrict its use.

reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25: Dzen publishes no HTTP API for channel content. The old RSS help pages https://dzen.ru/help/website/rss-modes.html and https://dzen.ru/help/ru/website/rss-modes.html answer 404; the current help (https://dzen.ru/help/ru/export-content/export.html, 'Технические требования к RSS-ленте', rendered in headless Chromium) documents only Dzen pulling a partner's RSS 2.0 feed into Новости/channels. There is no documented request an adapter could send to post, read comments or delete.
